review.reason: The patch label applies: the VMS Alpha parser is reachable in this artifact and contains the selected truncated-record bounds check.
evidence: Target and x86-64 debug companion match Build-ID e1affb7f21f7c79357d551f9e2a1236ebbcf0a43 and debuglink CRC32 0x5f085911.

Retained build configuration uses --enable-targets=all --disable-shared --enable-static. The artifact registers alpha_vms_vec at 0x15ac1c0, whose object-recognition callback points to alpha_vms_object_p at 0x85aca0.
display_object_bfd calls bfd_check_format_matches with bfd_object at 0x5f64fa; that function dispatches through the registered format callback, establishing parser reachability.
At 0x85ae6d–0x85ae71, the parser rejects record sizes below 12 before the subtraction at 0x85ae73 and subsequent bfd_bread call.
binutils-2_30 contains selected fix 8a2df5e2df374289e00ecd8f099eb46d76ef982e; the observed machine-code guard matches its bfd/vms-alpha.c change.

review.reason: The vuln label applies: the artifact exposes the VMS Alpha parser and retains the unchecked record-size subtraction underlying this CVE.
evidence: Target and x86-64 debug companion match Build-ID 5a528e8a954a3328a6750c0b2a8a7956036a851b and debuglink CRC32 0xce229503.
The artifact advertises vms-alpha and registers alpha_vms_vec at 0x15444e0. Its object-recognition callback points to alpha_vms_object_p at 0x82a800.
display_object_bfd calls bfd_check_format_matches with bfd_object at 0x5d746a; format dispatch invokes the registered backend callback.

The parser allocates 12 bytes at 0x82a866–0x82a86b. For nonzero record sizes below 12, subtraction at 0x82ab15 occurs without the required lower-bound check, permitting unsigned underflow and an oversized bfd_bread into the buffer at 0x82aafb.
binutils-2_28 lacks selected fix 8a2df5e2df374289e00ecd8f099eb46d76ef982e; its source matches the observed vulnerable subtraction/read sequence.

review.reason: This artifact is outside the CVE's configuration scope because its registered BFD backends exclude VMS Alpha. The conclusion is artifact-specific, not inferred from symbol absence or host architecture.
evidence: Target and x86-64 debug companion match Build-ID 8b4e9cdd66b7fb230f42e28dfc86d5b6e6763d28 and debuglink CRC32 0x8bffac6c.
Decoded artifact backend table at 0x295d60 contains 20 registered targets, none supporting VMS Alpha. The runtime --help target list independently agrees.
Running this artifact with -b vms-alpha -f on an existing ELF returns 'Invalid bfd target'.
DT_NEEDED lists only libc.so.6; there is no dynamically supplied libbfd providing the missing backend.

Build provenance identifies an unmodified copied original artifact, not a rebuild under the current all-target adapter. Although binutils-2_29 source retains the vulnerable code, this artifact excludes the required backend.
review.suggested_action: Classify this artifact as not_affected; exclude it from vulnerable examples.

Target disassembly checks record size at 0x84ef53 and validates module-name/version boundaries at 0x84efbb, 0x84efd1, 0x84eff4 and 0x84f009 before printing.

review.reason: The vuln label applies: VMS Alpha private-header printing is reachable and retains the unchecked counted-string handling.
evidence: Target/debug Build-ID is 5a528e8a954a3328a6750c0b2a8a7956036a851b; debuglink CRC32 0xce229503 matches.
Target --help advertises vms-alpha. Registered alpha_vms_vec dispatches private-header printing to 0x828cc0; evax_bfd_print_eobj calls evax_bfd_print_emh at 0x826a22.
Within evax_bfd_print_emh, 0x81dae3 through 0x81db4b consumes counted module-name/version strings and advances their pointers without the selected record-boundary checks.
Tag binutils-2_28 lacks fix 8bdf0be19d2777565a8b1c88347f65d6a4b8c5fc; its bfd/vms-alpha.c implementation agrees with the vulnerable target instructions.

review.reason: This particular artifact cannot enter the VMS Alpha parser required by the CVE. The exclusion is established by registered backends and runtime rejection, not missing symbols or host architecture alone.

review.reason: The patch label applies: the reachable Mach-O reader rejects the UINT_MAX string-table size before strsize+1 allocation.
evidence: Target/debug Build-ID is e1affb7f21f7c79357d551f9e2a1236ebbcf0a43; debuglink CRC matches.

Target --help advertises Mach-O formats. Registered Mach-O vectors dispatch symbol canonicalization to 0xa32530, which reaches bfd_mach_o_read_symtab_symbols and bfd_mach_o_read_symtab_strtab at 0xa32340.
At 0xa32390, cmp edx,0xffffffff followed by je rejects the overflowing string-table size before the allocation at 0xa32398.
Tag binutils-2_30 contains selected fix 8bdf0be19d2777565a8b1c88347f65d6a4b8c5fc.

review.reason: The vuln label applies: the reachable Mach-O reader retains the overflowing allocation-size calculation.
evidence: Target/debug Build-ID is 5a528e8a954a3328a6750c0b2a8a7956036a851b; debuglink CRC matches.
Target --help advertises Mach-O. Registered Mach-O symbol callbacks reach bfd_mach_o_canonicalize_symtab at 0xa012c0 and then bfd_mach_o_read_symtab_strtab at 0xa010d0.
At 0xa01160, lea esi,[rdx+1] performs 32-bit strsize+1 arithmetic immediately before bfd_alloc, without rejecting UINT_MAX; the later read uses the original strsize.
The selected 8bdf0be19d27 fix is absent from binutils-2_28, and the target instructions match its unguarded bfd/mach-o.c implementation.

review.reason: This artifact lacks a selectable Mach-O reader, so the CVE's crafted-Mach-O precondition cannot reach the affected routine.

review.reason: The artifact is outside this CVE's configured scope: it cannot perform AArch64 disassembly. Source-level fix containment does not make it an applicable patched example.
evidence: Target/debug Build-ID is 8b4e9cdd66b7fb230f42e28dfc86d5b6e6763d28; debuglink CRC matches.
Target --help lists x86-family architectures and no AArch64. Explicit -d -m aarch64 selection returns 'can't use supplied machine aarch64'.
Compiled disassembler at 0xa01b0 only selects the x86 decoder for architecture IDs 9 through 12 and otherwise returns NULL.
Although binutils-2_29 contains cd3ea7c69acc5045eb28f9bf80d923116e15e4f5, independent artifact dispatch and runtime evidence establish that the required AArch64 decoder is excluded.
review.suggested_action: Record configuration-specific not_affected; exclude this artifact from the patched pair.

review.reason: The patch label applies: the x86-64 executable includes a reachable AArch64 decoder with the selected array-index guard.
evidence: Target/debug Build-ID is e1affb7f21f7c79357d551f9e2a1236ebbcf0a43; debuglink CRC matches.

Target --help advertises AArch64. Compiled disassembler dispatch returns print_insn_aarch64 at 0x635df0; its decoding chain reaches aarch64_extract_operand, whose branch at 0x63e983 enters aarch64_ext_ldst_reglist.
At 0x6340c7, cmp edx,0xa followed by ja rejects indices above 10 before accessing the 11-element data array.
Tag binutils-2_30 contains cd3ea7c69acc5045eb28f9bf80d923116e15e4f5, whose actual changed file is opcodes/aarch64-dis.c.

review.reason: The vuln label applies: this executable supports AArch64 disassembly and retains the reachable unchecked opcode-derived array access.
evidence: Target/debug Build-ID is 5a528e8a954a3328a6750c0b2a8a7956036a851b; debuglink CRC matches.

Target --help advertises AArch64. Compiled disassembler dispatch selects print_insn_aarch64 at 0x611340; the decoding chain reaches aarch64_extract_operand, which branches to aarch64_ext_ldst_reglist at 0x618520.
After opcode extraction at 0x60f61a, instructions at 0x60f624 and 0x60f628 scale and use the index without checking it against the 11-element data array.
Tag binutils-2_28 lacks cd3ea7c69acc5045eb28f9bf80d923116e15e4f5; opcodes/aarch64-dis.c contains the corresponding unguarded access.
